title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 t

translated_title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation：以像素即代码实现智能体视觉创作
translated_abstract: 视觉创作既需要富有表现力的图像，又需要对文本、布局和结构的精确控制。我们提出了Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation，这是一个通过“像素即代码”将这两种能力连接起来的智能体框架。光栅图像通过学习到的离散视觉token来表示，而结构化制品则使用显式程序。一个共享的生成与渲染接口将这些表示与跨越图像、矢量图形、网页和文档的视觉反馈连接起来。Nemotron原生的协调框架负责规划与光栅候选选择，并对可编辑的结构化和混合制品进行针对性修复。为支持这一接口，我们开发了Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer、自回归光栅生成器Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B，以及结构化代码模型家族Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode。在涵盖六个视觉领域的约17.8万张图像上，我们的tokenizer将重建PSNR从26.08提升至……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“像素即代码”的智能体视觉创作框架，用离散视觉token表示光栅图像、用显式程序表示结构化制品，并配套开发了图像tokenizer、自回归光栅生成器和结构化代码模型，统一实现了对图像、矢量图形、网页和文档的生成、渲染与修复。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic "Pixel as Code" framework that represents raster images with discrete visual tokens and structured artifacts with explicit programs, supported by a new image tokenizer, a 30B autoregressive raster generator, and a vision-code model family to unify generation, rendering, and repair across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents.
